question: What is a patient?

results.definition: An individual to whom a billable healthcare service, charge, account or claim is associated for revenue-cycle processing.
results.governance_note: One of three surviving definitions inherited through the merger. No enterprise-wide canonical definition has been declared.

results.definition: An individual receiving or registered to receive clinical assessment, treatment, monitoring or care from Northgate Health Group.
results.governance_note: One of three surviving definitions inherited through the merger. No enterprise-wide canonical definition has been declared.

results.definition: An individual whose healthcare information is represented in an approved research dataset or study population.
results.governance_note: One of three surviving definitions inherited through the merger. No enterprise-wide canonical definition has been declared.

final_answer:
There is no enterprise-wide canonical definition of **patient**. Three active definitions exist:

- **Clinical:** An individual receiving or registered to receive clinical assessment, treatment, monitoring, or care from Northgate Health Group. (northgate://glossary/patient-clinical)
- **Revenue Cycle:** An individual associated with a billable healthcare service, charge, account, or claim. (northgate://glossary/patient-billing)
- **Research:** An individual whose healthcare information appears in an approved research dataset or study population. (northgate://glossary/patient-research)
